_readme: Single source of truth for categories. Read by pipeline/filter.py and by the site (src/lib/constants/categories.js).
categories  decide what goes into the dataset. Each term is a word stem looked up in ALL scraped reports
('nazi' also matches 'nazis', 'naziparole'). A report matching any term of any category is kept.
Term order = which sentence is quoted on the timeline: the first term found wins, so put generic wording last.
kind says what a category records: 'offence' = the law the police cite (kennzeichen also lists the
symbols themselves), 'motive' = the motive as the police word it.
color / colorEnd: each box on the timeline fades from color to colorEnd, reaching it at
gradientEndAt percent of the box width.
commentary  curated views on top of the dataset. Terms are searched only within reports already in the dataset
(plain text match, 'a+b' = both words). They never pull a report in. On the categorical timeline a
matching report is highlighted (all commentary shares one yellow).
An entry with 'region' instead of 'terms' matches by which police force published the report.

categories.label: Symbols of unconstitutional organisations
categories.desc: Use of symbols of unconstitutional and terrorist organisations (§86a StGB): swastikas, Hitler salutes, SS runes, the red Hamas triangle. The largest category in the dataset.

categories.label: Incitement to hatred
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes under §130 StGB: incitement to hatred.

categories.label: Antisemitism
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes focussed on antisemitic incidents: graffiti, threats, physical attacks.

categories.label: Racism
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes directed at a person's attributed or actual ethnic origin or skin colour.

categories.label: Xenophobia
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes recorded as xenophobic: the police umbrella term for hostility towards people perceived as foreign.

categories.label: Hostility towards foreigners
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes in which the prejudice refers to a nationality other than German.

categories.label: Islamophobia
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes including incidents targeting Muslims and Muslim institutions.

categories.label: Anti-LGBTQ+ violence
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes targeting LGBTQ+ people.

categories.label: Misogyny
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes directed against women. It rarely appears in police reports and is therefore underrepresented.

categories.label: Ableism
categories.desc: Politically motivated crimes targeting people with disabilities.

commentary.label: Palestine / Gaza
commentary.desc: Police reports mentioning Palestine or Gaza are often classified as anti-Semitic crimes, censoring political protest as a hate crime.

commentary.label: Headscarf
commentary.desc: Reports that mention a headscarf. The police rarely name Islamophobia as a motive, so these cases mostly appear under racism or xenophobia.

commentary.label: State security police (LKA)
commentary.desc: Reports in which the state security division of the State Criminal Police Office takes over the investigation, i.e. the police themselves treat the case as politically motivated.

commentary.label: Berlin
commentary.desc: Reports published by the Berlin police.

commentary.label: Brandenburg
commentary.desc: Reports published by the Brandenburg police.
